video_title: Knicks WILD Celebrations Continue, Take Mikal's Phone Away! + Brunson vs SGA: Who is Better PG?

quotes.speaker: Paul Pierce
quotes.summary_phrase: Paul Pierce calls the regular season hype for Luka Doncic gas
quotes.excerpt: All this regular season hype is just gas to me. He's ahead of SGA and Luka.
quotes.quote: I don't care what you're doing in the regular season no more. All this regular season hype is just gas to me. He's ahead of SGA and Luka. He's the best point guard right now in the league.

quotes.speaker: Danny Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Danny Green admits he underestimated the Toronto championship parade
quotes.excerpt: I underestimated how crazy the shit was going to be. It was five hours.
quotes.quote: I got a chance to be a part of two really good ones. One really good one and one that was, bro, I underestimated how crazy the shit was going to be. It was five hours. It was supposed to be like an hour and a half, you know, I'm thinking, okay, bro, it was five hours.

quotes.speaker: Danny Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Danny Green on the difference between boat and bus parades
quotes.excerpt: We were in a boat, so it kept us moving. But it's not as interactive as the bus.
quotes.quote: We were in a boat, so it kept us moving. Fans on buildings were crazy, so like, we were able to move. You're drinking, but it's not as interactive as the bus. But the San Antonio one was my first one. I'm like, damn, yo, you got people from all over Texas on buildings and hotels, crazy, great footage. But Toronto, something else, bro. Like, very special, bro.

quotes.speaker: Danny Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Danny Green on why Marcus Smart didn't speak at the parade
quotes.excerpt: Marcus Smart, bro. I was like, we can't give him the mic. He was gone.
quotes.quote: Marcus Smart, bro. I was like, we can't give him the mic. He was gone. We can't give him the mic. So when we sat down on stage, Kawhi had the little, you know, should we get Mark up there? I'm like, Mark was sitting behind me and I'm like, I don't think we should do this. And what let me know that we could not get like, I think he bit me or some shit like that. And I'm like, what the fuck? I was like, you know, he was doing that to, he was the bottles going crazy and we sat down.

quotes.speaker: Paul Pierce
quotes.summary_phrase: Paul Pierce on the Lakers' lack of championship parades
quotes.excerpt: The Lakers don't parade through the city. They just have something in front of the arena.
quotes.quote: The Lakers don't parade through the city. They just have something in front of the arena on the stage. Not downtown.

quotes.speaker: Paul Pierce
quotes.summary_phrase: Paul Pierce ranks Jalen Brunson as a top-five NBA player
quotes.excerpt: Jalen Brunson, a top-five NBA player after this run. Right above Anthony Edwards, right behind Luka Doncic.
quotes.quote: People are asking is Jalen Brunson a top-five NBA player after this run? Who are your top-five players in your opinion? Even my old job, The Ringer, I seen they put him at number five, right above Anthony Edwards, right behind Luka Doncic.

quotes.speaker: Danny Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Danny Green's top-four players list
quotes.excerpt: You got Giannis, Wemby, Jokic, right? Those three for sure. SGA. Those are like top four.
quotes.quote: After that, it's like, who's winning? Who's bringing their team to win, right? Like, Giannis, Wemby, Jokic, right? Those three for sure. SGA. Those are like top four. After that, it's like, who's winning? Who's bringing their team to win, right?

quotes.speaker: Danny Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Danny Green on Jalen Brunson's growth as a player
quotes.excerpt: Even though he didn't take a step back in the finals, allowing the team that made him better.
quotes.quote: Even though he didn't take a step back in the finals, but like to allow the team, that made him even more like better looking, like a better player.

quotes.speaker: Paul Pierce
quotes.summary_phrase: Paul Pierce on Jalen Brunson's clutch performance against San Antonio
quotes.excerpt: He played better than Shai against San Antonio. He's top five for sure.
quotes.quote: You can't say Anthony Edwards was better than Jalen Brunson in this last playoff. He had a knee issue, but no. He played better than Shai against San Antonio. He's top five for sure.

quotes.speaker: Paul Pierce
quotes.summary_phrase: Paul Pierce on the importance of playoff performance for legacy
quotes.excerpt: Everything moving forward is predicated on your playoff run. I don't care what you do in the regular season.
quotes.quote: Everything moving forward is predicated on your playoff run. I don't care what you do in the regular season no more. All this regular season hype is just gas to me. It really is, because I mean, you think about it, you play the best of the best in the playoffs. So your stats can be inflated. You're not playing the Wizards. Half the teams are not that great on defense. So you can get 15 versus them. I mean, 30 versus them and 15 versus the other ones, you're going to average 25. Like, 23, 24. And so, it's what you do in the playoffs says a lot because every, you're either going to play against an MVP candidate, you're going to be playing against a top-tier defense. Once you pass the first round, it gets real. And so, that's from here on out, don't tell me nothing unless you do it in the playoffs.

quotes.speaker: Paul Pierce
quotes.summary_phrase: Paul Pierce on the Giannis Antetokounmpo trade rumors
quotes.excerpt: As the NBA draft approaches, Giannis trade talks and rumors of trade starts are heating up.
quotes.quote: As the NBA draft approaches, Giannis trade talks and rumors of trade starts are heating up. The Heat and the Celtics remain far and away the frontrunners to land Giannis, according to NBC Sports League sources.

quotes.speaker: Paul Pierce
quotes.summary_phrase: Paul Pierce on the Celtics' trade assets
quotes.excerpt: They have a strong package. So they're trying to make the package. Yeah, they're trying to make the package.
quotes.quote: They have a strong package. So they're trying to make the package. Yeah, they're trying to make the package.

quotes.speaker: Paul Pierce
quotes.summary_phrase: Paul Pierce on the difficulty of trading for Giannis Antetokounmpo
quotes.excerpt: If they were to do this when he had two years left on his deal, teams would be like.
quotes.quote: If they were to do this when he had two years left on his deal, teams would be like, fuck it, he ain't got to sign an extension. I got two years of Giannis. I don't give a fuck. I'm trading for this dude. But now it's like, all right, I trade for him, he got one year left on his deal. If he doesn't want to be here, he can come and look at all the bullshit he was doing in Milwaukee. Right. You heard about Miles Turner was like, this nigga was two hours late to every team ride.

quotes.speaker: Danny Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Danny Green on the importance of team quality over individual stars
quotes.excerpt: I think we're moving into an era of the NBA where it is more about the team quality.
quotes.quote: I think we're moving into an era of the NBA where it is more about the team quality than just having the individual guy who's amazing in his own right. You know, I think you do need that that quality up and down the roster.

quotes.speaker: Paul Pierce
quotes.summary_phrase: Paul Pierce on the parity of the Eastern Conference
quotes.excerpt: Is the Knicks championship proof that the Eastern Conference is slightly underrated? Yeah, it really is.
quotes.quote: Is the Knicks championship proof that the Eastern Conference is slightly underrated? Yeah, it really is. I mean, I mean, you look, it's pretty much every other year, West, East, it feels like back and forth. It's been back and forth. I mean, you can take out 10 titles that Boston won in the 60s and it's tied. You know what I'm saying? So it's pretty like back and forth. You know, so, I mean, I think the Eastern Conference doesn't have the same star power. That's why it's looked at as the weaker conference because when you talk about the star of stars, Wemby, Jokic, Shay, LeBron, you know what I'm saying? All the super stars are on the West. You know, that's why it's more star power. Yeah, it's just more star power.

quotes.speaker: Danny Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Danny Green on the competitiveness of top Eastern Conference teams
quotes.excerpt: I just think the top teams are way more just that much better to be able to compete.
quotes.quote: I just think the top teams are way more just that much better to be able to compete match-up wise with the West team. Like it's not like the the bulk of the East is better than the West. I just think the top teams are as good as the top teams in the West. Does that make sense?

quotes.speaker: Paul Pierce
quotes.summary_phrase: Paul Pierce on the Pacers' potential as a playoff team
quotes.excerpt: The Pacers, last just last year, OKC was everybody's idea of a juggernaut.
quotes.quote: The Pacers, last just last year, OKC was everybody's idea of a juggernaut. 60s, high 60s in wins. They were right there with those guys in a seven-game series. You know, right there before a guy goes down with an injury. The Knicks, like, I think they would have been competitive with any team that came out of the West, if not straight up, beat them.

quotes.speaker: Paul Pierce
quotes.summary_phrase: Paul Pierce on the parity of the NBA
quotes.excerpt: I don't know if we have a different champion. Like, different than the last eight years.
quotes.quote: I don't know if we have a different champion. Like, different than the last eight years. It's going to be one of those. Yeah. And yeah, it might be in there. Again, let's see.

quotes.speaker: Paul Pierce
quotes.summary_phrase: Paul Pierce on the importance of team depth
quotes.excerpt: Both teams have space. Both teams can make moves, and I think San Antonio, they need to.
quotes.quote: Both teams have space. Both teams can make moves, and I think San Antonio, they need to change much. They'll add a piece or two that I think you'd be like, oh. Yeah, we'll see, we'll see what happens in the off season.

quotes.speaker: Danny Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Danny Green on the likelihood of players joining San Antonio
quotes.excerpt: I think more people are more likely to go to San Antonio, they'll probably see.
quotes.quote: I think more people are more likely to go to San Antonio, they'll probably see that like a player might be upset in another situation where you're just like, oh damn, okay. But I doubt it, I don't see it right now. Like, the draft may tell some, it's not going to tell enough. Some of the league ain't going to tell much. It's because the time is against like against them right now.
